Services

Your First Fleet

A structured feasibility study that evaluates whether robotic systems can deliver real value on your construction sites.

Get Started

Proven results

Find out where robotics makes sense on your sites before you invest in hardware.

Construction robotics is no longer experimental. But not every task is worth automating, and not every robot fits every site. The difference between a successful pilot and an expensive disappointment is the analysis you do before you buy. We help you get that analysis right.

Site & Task Analysis

Systematic evaluation of your site operations to identify which tasks are repetitive, physically demanding, or quality critical enough to justify robotic automation.

Technology Matching

Technology scouting and matching that compares available robotic systems against your specific site conditions, project types, and workforce structure.

Fleet Planning

Fleet sizing and deployment planning that shows you exactly how many units you need, where to deploy them first, and what return to expect.

* Assessment outcomes depend on project type, site conditions, and task complexity. Figures based on feasibility studies conducted with general contractors in Germany.

How the study runs

  1. Site Operations Analysis

    We start by documenting how your sites actually run. Which tasks consume the most labor hours? Where do quality issues repeat? Which operations create safety risks or slow down the schedule? We observe, interview site teams, and analyze your project data to build a clear picture of where robotic systems could have the highest impact. This is not a desktop study. We visit your sites and talk to the people doing the work.

  2. Technology Evaluation and Matching

    Based on the site analysis, we evaluate which robotic systems on the market match your needs. We assess capabilities, limitations, site requirements, and integration effort for each option. Not every robot works on every site. We filter out what does not fit and focus on the systems that can realistically operate in your environment, with your logistics, and alongside your crews.

  3. Pilot Plan and Business Case

    We deliver a concrete pilot plan: which sites, which tasks, how many units, what infrastructure is needed, and what the expected return looks like. The business case includes capital costs, operational savings, deployment timeline, and risk factors. You get a document you can take to your board or investors with confidence, not a generic slide deck about the future of construction.

Built for contractors who want to move fast but invest smart.

Starting with robotics on construction sites is not about buying the newest machine. It is about understanding which tasks justify the investment, which technology fits your operations, and how to scale from a first pilot to a productive fleet. We bring the construction experience and the technology knowledge together so you can make decisions based on data, not marketing brochures.

What makes our assessment different

  • Independent assessment with no ties to any robotics manufacturer or reseller
  • Analysis based on your real site conditions, not lab environments or demo setups
  • Pilot plan sized for a small fleet you can deploy and evaluate within one project cycle

Thinking about a first pilot?

Tell us which site operations cost you the most and we will tell you whether robotics is the right answer, including when it is not.
